text: Minorities can overcome the promotion gap in corporate America if their superiors see them as value enhancers, and promoted minorities tend to share characteristics such as risk-taking, overconfidence, team play, and a perceived capacity to manage other non-whites.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Technology and Race in Corporate America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3071378

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Technology and Race in Corporate America

abstract: However, some evidence exists that minorities can overcome the promotion gap in corporate America if they are seen as value enhancers by their superiors.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: where superiors perceive the minority employee as value enhancing
